title: Apollo 13 · Houston, we’ve had a problem
description: An oxygen tank bursts 200,000 miles from Earth, and nobody yet knows what has happened.

characters.name: Jim Lovell
characters.role: Commander · the one who sees the gas through the hatch window

characters.name: Jack Swigert
characters.role: Command module pilot · he stirred the tanks, and reports first

characters.name: Fred Haise
characters.role: Lunar module pilot · reading the gauges as the power goes

characters.name: Jack Lousma
characters.role: CapCom in Houston · the only voice the crew hear

characters.name: Gene Kranz
characters.role: Flight director · on Mission Control’s own loop

cues.speaker: capcom
cues.text: 13, we’ve got one more item for you, when you get a chance. We’d like you to stir up your cryo tanks.

cues.speaker: capcom
cues.text: In addition, I have shaft and trunnion…

cues.speaker: swigert
cues.text: Okay.

cues.speaker: capcom
cues.text: …for looking at the Comet Bennett, if you need it.

cues.speaker: swigert
cues.text: Okay. Stand by.

cues.speaker: swigert
cues.text: (Swigert switches on the fans in the oxygen tanks.)

cues.speaker: swigert
cues.text: (A bang. The master alarm sounds.)

cues.speaker: swigert
cues.text: Okay, Houston, we’ve had a problem here.

cues.speaker: capcom
cues.text: This is Houston. Say again, please.

cues.speaker: lovell
cues.text: Houston, we’ve had a problem. We’ve had a Main B Bus Undervolt.

cues.speaker: capcom
cues.text: Roger. Main B Undervolt.

cues.speaker: capcom
cues.text: Okay, stand by, 13. We’re looking at it.

cues.speaker: haise
cues.text: Okay. Right now, Houston, the voltage is looking good. And we had a pretty large bang associated with the Caution and Warning there.

cues.speaker: haise
cues.text: And as I recall, Main B was the one that had had an amp spike on it once before.

cues.speaker: capcom
cues.text: Roger, Fred.

cues.speaker: haise
cues.text: In the interim here, we’re starting to go ahead and button up the tunnel again.

cues.speaker: capcom
cues.text: Roger.

cues.speaker: haise
cues.text: That jolt must have rocked the sensor on O2 Quantity 2. It was oscillating down around 20 to 60 percent. Now it’s full-scale high again.

cues.speaker: capcom
cues.text: Roger.

cues.speaker: lovell
cues.text: And, Houston, we had a Restart on our computer and we had a PGNCS light and the Restart Reset.

cues.speaker: capcom
cues.text: Roger. Restart and a PGNCS light.

cues.speaker: haise
cues.text: Okay, AC 2 is showing zip. I’m going to try to reconfigure on that, Jack.

cues.speaker: capcom
cues.text: Roger.

cues.speaker: haise
cues.text: We got a Main Bus A Undervolt now, too, showing.

cues.speaker: capcom
cues.text: Main A Undervolt.

cues.speaker: haise
cues.text: It’s reading about 25½. Main B is reading zip right now.

cues.speaker: lovell
cues.text: (Ten minutes later.)

cues.speaker: lovell
cues.text: And, Jack, our O2 quantity number 2 tank is reading zero. Did you get that?

cues.speaker: capcom
cues.text: O2 Quantity number 2 is zero.

cues.speaker: lovell
cues.text: And it looks to me, looking out the hatch, that we are venting something.

cues.speaker: lovell
cues.text: We are venting something out into the… into space.

cues.speaker: capcom
cues.text: Roger. We copy your venting.

cues.speaker: lovell
cues.text: It’s a gas of some sort.

cues.speaker: kranz
cues.text: Okay now, let’s everybody keep cool. We got the LM still attached, the LM spacecraft’s good,

cues.speaker: kranz
cues.text: so if we need to get back home we’ve got a LM to do a good portion of it with.
